name: What is the typical process for getting an interior repair done with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for getting an interior repair done with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins when you contact us to discuss your repair needs. We then schedule a convenient time for an on-site visit to your property in areas like Garden City or Meridian. During this visit, our team assesses the repair, discusses potential solutions, and gathers necessary information to provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we schedule the work, manage materials, and complete the repair with minimal disruption to your home. We prioritize clear communication throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial contact, an on-site assessment for an estimate, approval, and then scheduling and completing the repair.
